ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, battery E is marked with internal resistance r, and switch S is on the power-supply branch; voltmeter V is connected across the two terminals of the power supply, used to measure the terminal voltage. The external circuit goes from the left end through R1 to a node and then divides into two branches: the upper branch is R2, and the lower branch is R3 in series with ideal ammeter A; the two branches then merge again at the right end. Therefore when S is closed, the external circuit is equivalent to R1 in series with (R2∥R3), and A measures the current in the R3 branch. Then reason: If R2 is open-circuited, then only the R3 branch remains in the parallel part, and the external resistance changes from R1+(R2∥R3) to R1+R3. Because R2∥R3<R3, the external resistance increases. The increase of external resistance makes the total current I decrease, the voltage drop Ir on the battery internal resistance r decreases, and the terminal voltage U=E-Ir increases, so the reading of V becomes larger. For meter A, before the fault the R3 branch current is I3前=E·R2/[(r+R1)(R2+R3)+R2R3]; after R2 is open-circuited, R3 becomes the only branch, I3后=E/(r+R1+R3). Comparison gives I3后>I3前, so the reading of A also becomes larger. Therefore the fault consistent with the condition that the readings of V and A both become larger is R2 open circuit.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出电路结构：电池E带内阻r，开关S闭合后，外电路为R1串联一个并联部分；并联部分上支路是R2，下支路是R3与理想电流表A串联；理想电压表V接在电源两端，测电源路端电压。由题文读出：故障发生后V、A读数都变大。判断可能故障时可设R2断路：此时外电路总电阻由R1+(R2∥R3)变为R1+R3，外电阻增大，总电流减小，因此内阻r上的电压降Ir减小，路端电压U=E-Ir增大，符合V变大；同时原来R3支路只分得并联部分电流的一部分，R2断路后R3成为唯一通路，且可比较 I3前=E·R2/[(r+R1)(R2+R3)+R2R3]，I3后=E/(r+R1+R3)，有I3后>I3前，因此A读数也变大。故可能故障为R2断路。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中电池E标有内阻r，开关S在电源支路上；电压表V接在电源两端，用来测路端电压。外电路从左端经R1到一个节点后分成两支：上支路为R2，下支路为R3与理想电流表A串联，两支路再汇合到右端。因此S闭合时，外电路等效为R1串联(R2∥R3)，A测R3支路电流。再推理：若R2断路，则并联部分只剩R3支路，外电阻由R1+(R2∥R3)变为R1+R3，因为R2∥R3<R3，所以外电阻增大。外电阻增大使总电流I减小，电池内阻r上的电压降Ir减小，路端电压U=E-Ir增大，所以V读数变大。对A表，故障前R3支路电流为I3前=E·R2/[(r+R1)(R2+R3)+R2R3]；R2断路后R3成为唯一支路，I3后=E/(r+R1+R3)。比较可得I3后>I3前，所以A读数也变大。故与题设V、A读数均变大相符的故障是R2断路。
